mapper.sql: SELECT template_id, wvta_coc_no, coc_template_no, model_no, version, vehicle_type, status, validate_result, validate_time, validate_msg, json, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, filepath, is_last, overdue_date, template_version, tvv, effective_date, uuid, generate_affirm, upload_affirm FROM vehicle_template vt
mapper.select: select template_id, coc_template_no, version, template_version from vehicle_template where status = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_template (wvta_coc_no, coc_template_no,model_no, version, vehicle_type, status, validate_result, json, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, uuid, overdue_date, template_version, tvv, effective_date, generate_affirm, upload_affirm) VALUES (#{wvtaCocNo}, #{cocTemplateNo}, #{modelNo}, #{version}, #{vehicleType}, #{status}, #{validateResult}, #{json}, #{remark}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{uuid}, #{overdueDate}, #{templateVersion}, #{tvv}, #{effectiveDate}, #{generateAffirm}, #{uploadAffirm})
mapper.update:
UPDATE vehicle_template
wvta_coc_no = #{wvtaCocNo},
coc_template_no = #{cocTemplateNo},
model_no = #{modelNo},
version = #{version},
vehicle_type = #{vehicleType},
json = #{json},
remark = #{remark},
overdue_date = #{overdueDate}
template_version = #{templateVersion}
tvv = #{tvv}
effective_date = #{effectiveDate}
generate_affirm = #{generateAffirm},
upload_affirm = #{uploadAffirm},
update_by = #{updateBy},
update_time = SYSDATE()
WHERE template_id = #{templateId}

UPDATE vehicle_template SET del_flag = '2', update_time = SYSDATE() WHERE template_id IN
#{id}
UPDATE vehicle_template SET status = #{status}, update_time = SYSDATE() WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
UPDATE vehicle_template SET validate_result = #{validateResult}, validate_msg= #{validateMsg}, validate_time = SYSDATE() WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vehicle_template WHERE uuid = #{uuid} ORDER BY cast(version as UNSIGNED) desc limit 1
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle_template set is_last = 0 where uuid = #{uuid}
mapper.select: SELECT vt.template_id, vt.wvta_coc_no, vt.coc_template_no, vt.model_no, vt.version, vt.vehicle_type, vt.status, vt.validate_result, vt.validate_time, vt.validate_msg, vt.json, vt.remark, vt.create_by, vt.create_time, vt.update_by, vt.update_time, vt.filepath, vt.is_last, vt.uuid, vt.overdue_date, vt.template_version, vt.effective_date, vt.tvv FROM vehicle_template vt INNER JOIN sys_dict_data sdd ON sdd.dict_type = 'reminder_time' AND sdd.status = '0' and dict_sort = 0 WHERE vt.del_flag = '0' AND vt.effective_date IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, NOW(), vt.effective_date) / 1000 <= CAST(sdd.dict_value AS SIGNED) AND vt.effective_date > NOW()

SELECT vt.*, vt.json->>'$.Make' AS brand, vt.json->>'$.ActualMass' AS weight, vt.json->>'$.CommercialName' AS sale_name, vt.json->>'$.TyreSize' AS tire, CASE WHEN vt.effective_date = max_ed.max_effective_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_last FROM vehicle_template vt LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tvv, MAX(effective_date) AS max_effective_date FROM vehicle_template WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '0' GROUP BY tvv ) max_ed ON max_ed.tvv = vt.tvv LEFT JOIN material m ON m.vehicle_template_id = vt.template_id WHERE vt.del_flag = '0' AND vt.status = '0' and vt.is_last = 1
AND m.material_no = #{materialNo}
AND REPLACE(vt.tvv, ',', '') = #{tvv}
AND vt.json->>'$.Make' IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(#{brand}, REPLACE(REPLACE(vt.json->>'$.Make', ';', ','), ' ', '')) > 0
AND vt.json->>'$.ActualMass' IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(#{weight}, REPLACE(REPLACE(vt.json->>'$.ActualMass', ';', ','), ' ', '')) > 0
AND vt.json->>'$.CommercialName' IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(#{saleName}, REPLACE(REPLACE(vt.json->>'$.CommercialName', ';', ','), ' ', '')) > 0
AND vt.json->>'$.TyreSize' IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(#{tire}, REPLACE(REPLACE(vt.json->>'$.TyreSize', ';', ','), ' ', '')) > 0
ORDER BY CAST(vt.version AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) DESC
mapper.update: update vehicle_template set status = '1' where status = '0' and overdue_date is not null and overdue_date <= NOW();
mapper.select: SELECT vt.template_id, vt.wvta_coc_no, vt.coc_template_no, vt.model_no, vt.version, vt.vehicle_type, vt.status, vt.validate_result, vt.validate_time, vt.validate_msg, vt.json, vt.remark, vt.create_by, vt.create_time, vt.update_by, vt.update_time, vt.filepath, vt.is_last, vt.uuid, vt.overdue_date, vt.template_version, vt.effective_date, vt.tvv FROM vehicle_template vt INNER JOIN sys_dict_data sdd ON sdd.dict_type = 'reminder_time' AND sdd.status = '0' and dict_sort = 0 WHERE vt.del_flag = '0' and vt.overdue_date is not null and vt.no_next_version_notice = 0 AND DATE_SUB(vt.overdue_date, INTERVAL CAST(sdd.dict_value AS SIGNED) * 1000 MICROSECOND) < NOW() AND CAST(vt.version AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) = ( SELECT MAX(CAST(t2.version AS DECIMAL(10, 4))) FROM vehicle_template t2 WHERE t2.uuid = vt.uuid AND t2.del_flag = '0' )
